eula.title: Usage Notes
eula.subtitle: Please read the following before using E.L.L.A.
eula.accept: I have read and agree to the usage notes.
eula.offline: E.L.L.A. service unreachable. Please wait a moment and try again.

items.local_body: E.L.L.A. runs on your machine. No cloud, no tracking, no subscription.
items.openai_body: If you enter an OpenAI API key in settings, your messages will be sent to OpenAI servers. With Ollama, all data stays exclusively on your device.
items.system_body: E.L.L.A. can launch programs, clean temporary files, read emails and create calendar entries — but only on your explicit command.
items.boundary_body: Unread emails are never deleted. This boundary is technically anchored and cannot be overridden by any rule.
items.responsibility_body: You bear responsibility for all actions you instruct E.L.L.A. to take. Destructive actions (emptying trash, deleting temp files) are disabled by default and must be explicitly enabled.
